wiringInterpretation.rationale: Plan_final 04-004 wires the read-only TicRunner class (src/bootstrap/tryRunTics.ts) to live callbacks driven by the event queue from 03-006. The new src/vanilla/wireTryRunTics.ts exposes a mutable VanillaTryRunTicsState carrying per-callback counters (startTicInvocations, buildTiccmdInvocations, tickerInvocations, advanceDemoInvocations), a drainedEvents log, a renderInvalidated flag, and an advanceDemoRequested toggle. The buildVanillaTicCallbacks builder returns a TicCallbacks whose startTic drains the event queue into the log, buildTiccmd increments its counter and returns EMPTY_TICCMD (real ticcmd building lands in the player-weapons-items lane), ticker increments its counter and flips renderInvalidated, advancedemo proxies state.advanceDemoRequested live via a getter, and doAdvanceDemo clears the flag. The runVanillaTryRunTicsDriver function runs one TicRunner.tryRunTics call with these callbacks and returns the number of tics executed.
publicSurface: VanillaTryRunTicsState interface (mutable counters + drainedEvents log + renderInvalidated + advanceDemoRequested)
